title: Additive Manufacturing: Designs and Materials
summary: Let’s explore the Additive Manufacturing (AM) development of new technologies, and learn about different types of materials used in AM
body:
**On-Demand | 3 Hours 15 minutes**

Let’s explore the ***Additive Manufacturing (AM) development of new technologies***, and ***learn about different types of materials used in AM***.

Some case studies will be shared in this session to explain the AM solutions for complex challenges too!

In this session, we will talk about:

-   Opening & Company Introduction
-   Design for Additive Manufacturing
-   Metal Part Replacement with 3D Printing, Thermoplastics, Composite & Ceramics Technology
-   3D Printing Case Studies
